# muxt check reads a text/template variable's templates as text/template
# does: as text, not HTML. A '<' in JSON or prose, and an HTML comment
# that a control structure crosses, parse, and break and continue are
# keywords in template files.

! muxt check
cmpenv stderr want-err.txt

-- want-err.txt --
$WORK/main.go:22:6 ExecuteTemplate "data.json.tmpl" Data
$WORK/data.json.tmpl:1:55: executing "data.json.tmpl" at <.Missing>: field or method Missing not found on Data

$WORK/main.go:23:6 ExecuteTemplate "prose.txt.tmpl" Data
$WORK/prose.txt.tmpl:2:28: executing "prose.txt.tmpl" at <.Gone>: field or method Gone not found on Data

$WORK/main.go:24:6 ExecuteTemplate "literal" Data
literal:2:28: executing "literal" at <.Lost>: field or method Lost not found on Data

$WORK/main.go:25:6 ExecuteTemplate "def" Data
$WORK/def.json.tmpl:1:36: executing "def" at <.Nope>: field or method Nope not found on Data

-- data.json.tmpl --
{"a": "<x", "n": {{.N}}, "tag": "<{{.Name}}>", "m": {{.Missing}}}
-- def.json.tmpl --
{{define "def"}}{"a": "<x", "b": {{.Nope}}}{{end}}
-- prose.txt.tmpl --
Remember a < b and <3 {{.Name}}.
{{if .N}}<!-- {{end}} -->{{.Gone}}
{{range .Items}}{{if eq . "x"}}{{break}}{{end}}{{continue}}{{end}}
-- go.mod --
module example.com

go 1.24
-- main.go --
package main

import (
	"embed"
	"io"
	"text/template"
)

//go:embed *.tmpl
var source embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.Must(template.ParseFS(source, "*")).New("literal").Parse(`{"a": "<x"}
{{if .N}}<!-- {{end}} -->{{.Lost}}`))

type Data struct {
	N     int
	Name  string
	Items []string
}

func main() {
	_ = templates.ExecuteTemplate(io.Discard, "data.json.tmpl", Data{})
	_ = templates.ExecuteTemplate(io.Discard, "prose.txt.tmpl", Data{})
	_ = templates.ExecuteTemplate(io.Discard, "literal", Data{})
	_ = templates.ExecuteTemplate(io.Discard, "def", Data{})
}
